semiconductor_relevance: High — TankeBlue specializes in the production of SiC wafers and related products, which are critical for third-generation semiconductor applications.
summary: TankeBlue Semiconductor Co., Ltd. is a leading manufacturer of silicon carbide (SiC) wafers and related equipment in China. The company focuses on the research, development, and production of high-quality SiC substrates and epitaxial wafers, contributing significantly to the advancement of the third-generation semiconductor industry.
capabilities: Manufacture of SiC single crystal substrates
Development of SiC single crystal growth equipment
Production of high-quality 8-inch conductive SiC substrates

regional_presence.China: TankeBlue has its headquarters and multiple subsidiaries in China, focusing on advancing the local semiconductor industry.
